sloka: ततो मे जननी दीना तच्छरीरं पितुर्मम ।परिष्वज्य महाभागा प्रविष्टा हव्यवाहनम् ।। ७.१७.१५ ॥
transliteration: tato me jananī dīnā taccharīraṁ piturmama ।pariṣvajya mahābhāgā praviṣṭā havyavāhanam ।। 7.17.15 ॥

translations.english: My father, while sleeping at night, was killed by that wicked one.
